instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Mid-scale restaurant chain with 12 locations serving Mediterranean cuisine. Central kitchen produces 70% of menu items for distribution to satellite locations. Evaluating kitchen display systems, AI-driven prep quantity forecasting, and centralized procurement optimization. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions. Every 1% of margin improvement directly impacts our ability to reinvest in growth.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 6 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Centralized Supply Chain & Procurement Optimization
opportunities.rationale: With cost reduction being the dominant priority, centralizing procurement optimization offers immediate and measurable savings. Leveraging existing senior leadership capacity is key to negotiating better terms and eliminating local inefficiencies across 12 locations.

first_actions: Conduct a full SKU-level audit of all centralized items (70% production) to identify waste/overstocking.
Map current vendor relationships vs. potential consolidated sourcing options for the top 20 inputs.
Define and pilot a unified purchasing dashboard accessible by both central kitchen and satellite site managers.
execution_plan.success_metric: Targeted 5-8% reduction in Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) within 12 months.
milestones: Complete vendor consolidation analysis and negotiate pilot contracts.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Demand Forecasting for Production Planning
opportunities.rationale: To counteract margin compression, the company must move beyond basic forecasting to predictive planning. Integrating POS data (customer flow), marketing automation metrics (lead spikes/seasonal changes), and historical prep quantities will allow the central kitchen to dynamically scale output, minimizing spoilage and labor waste.

first_actions: Map all necessary data feeds: POS data, seasonal sales trends, local event schedules, and inventory levels into a single analytical lake.
Develop an MVP prediction model focused solely on the top 10 most variable ingredients.
Pilot the AI forecast output directly into the kitchen display system (KDS) for initial testing.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in perishable inventory waste by 15% within the pilot scope.
milestones: Successful integration and validation of initial data feeds.
AI model achieving >85% predictive accuracy for targeted SKUs.
Formalized process handover from 'Forecast' to 'Production Schedule'.

next_steps.action: Formalize a cross-functional Operational Process Mapping Workshop (Procurement -> Production -> Logistics) to identify single points of failure and standardize procedures.
Establish a formal Steering Committee mandate defining clear, measurable ROI targets for all future optimization projects (e.g., % margin improvement per initiative).
Conduct a targeted talent gap assessment focusing specifically on data governance, process automation expertise (RPA), and advanced analytics application within the current team structure.

key_weaknesses: Operational Silos: While central processes exist, local execution and data input from satellite locations often remain manual or inconsistent.
Culture Inertia: Resistance to adopting highly automated, AI-driven planning systems persists among veteran staff who are comfortable with current (though inefficient) workflows.
Process Governance: The company has good strategic intent but lacks mature governance checkpoints (SOPs) to ensure that improvements made in one area don't create bottlenecks in another.

improvements: Elevated organizational structure: Transition from founder-led to professional management with dedicated senior leaders and formalized strategic planning.
Increased digital maturity: Moving from Digital Maturity 3 to 4, demonstrating the capacity for advanced analytics infrastructure (data engineers).
Proven change management capability: Successful deployment of CRM system proves ability to execute structured IT projects.
persistent_gaps: Standardization gap: The biggest remaining weakness is translating 'partial' process maturity into consistent, scalable execution across all 12 locations.
Operational governance: Need clear mechanisms (SOPs and audit trails) to enforce standardized usage of new tools/processes.
achieved_milestones: Successful CRM deployment significantly streamlined sales pipeline management.
R&D function established with dedicated squads, providing the necessary technical capacity for complex data modeling.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant organizational maturation (senior hiring, formalized planning) and demonstrable increase in digital infrastructure capacity (DM 3 -> DM 4). The strategic focus sharpened acutely on quantifiable cost reduction via operational efficiency.
